# prismasdwan_site_hub_prefix_filter (Resource)

Manages a Prisma SD-WAN Site Hub Prefix Filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Palo Alto Networks Inc. 2025
#
# Sample resource example for "site_hub_prefix_filter".
# This file is generated - do not edit by hand.
#
# Before using this example, configure the Prisma SD-WAN provider:
#
#   terraform {
#     required_providers {
#       prismasdwan = {
#         source  = "paloaltonetworks/prismasdwan"
#       }
#     }
#   }
#
#   provider "prismasdwan" {
#     host          = "api.sase.paloaltonetworks.com"
#     client_id     = "acmeuser@12345.iam.panserviceaccount.com"
#     client_secret = "aaaaaaaa-bbbb-cccc-dddd-eeeeeeeeeeee"
#     scope         = "tsg_id:12345"
#     auth_url      = "https://auth.apps.paloaltonetworks.com/am/oauth2/access_token"
#   }

resource "prismasdwan_site_hub_prefix_filter" "example" {
  filters = [{
    elements    = ["example_elements"]
    ip_prefixes = ["10.10.0.0/16"]
    path        = ["example_path"]
    site        = jsonencode({})
    type        = "example_type"
    wn_path     = ["example_wn_path"]
  }]
  prefix_filter_id = "<prefix_filter_id>"
}
```
